about.metaDescription: Who we are: a Nepali property platform from MantraSphere Innovations Pvt. Ltd. for buying, selling and renting houses, land and flats across Nepal.
about.title: About us
about.lead: {company} helps people in Nepal buy, sell and rent property with clear prices, real photos and direct contact with owners.
about.body1: We are a Nepali company, {legal}, with our office in Siraha. We built this platform because searching for a house or a plot of land in Nepal too often means outdated listings, missing prices and confusing area units.

offer.buyers: Buyers and tenants: search by district, municipality, price and area in ropani-aana or bigha-kattha, then call or message the owner directly.
offer.owners: Owners: list a house, land, flat or shop in a few minutes from your phone, with simple paid plans for more visibility.
offer.agents: Agents and developers: manage many listings and enquiries from one dashboard.
offer.verified: Every listing is reviewed by our team before it goes live, and verified owners and agents are marked clearly.

about.promise: We show the real price whenever the owner gives one, we remove sold and expired listings, and we never sell your phone number or email to anyone.

emi.metaTitle: Home loan EMI calculator Nepal | MantraSphere
emi.metaDescription: Work out the monthly EMI, total interest and yearly repayment schedule for a home or land loan in Nepal. Enter amounts in lakh or crore.
emi.title: Home loan EMI calculator
emi.intro: See your monthly instalment, the total interest and how the balance falls each year. You can type amounts like “45 lakh” or “1.2 crore”.
emi.invalid: Enter a loan amount of at least Rs 10,000, a rate between 1% and 30%, and 1 to 30 years.
emi.bankRatesNote: Published base rates collected by our team. Your bank’s final rate depends on your profile; confirm before you apply.
emi.disclaimer: This calculator gives an estimate. Banks may add a service charge and change the rate during the loan period.
emi.how1: Banks in Nepal charge interest on the remaining balance every month. The fixed monthly instalment (EMI) is:
emi.how2: Here P is the loan amount, r is the yearly rate divided by 12 and by 100, and n is the number of months. In the early years most of each instalment pays interest; later most of it pays off the loan.

land.title: Land unit converter
land.intro: Convert between the hill system (ropani-aana-paisa-daam), the terai system (bigha-kattha-dhur), square feet and square metres.
land.invalid: Enter an area greater than zero.
land.tableCaption: The same area in every unit
land.referenceIntro: The hill and Kathmandu valley districts use ropani and aana; the terai districts use bigha and kattha.
land.note: Values follow the standard Survey Department conversions. Always confirm the area on the land ownership certificate (lalpurja).
